title: AFC Bot
description: Manage the Discord bot without touching the server.

unreachable.title: The bot is not answering
unreachable.body: We could not reach the bot. It may be offline, restarting, or the control API may not be configured on this server.
unreachable.hint: Everything else on the site is unaffected. If it stays like this, check that the bot process is running and that BOT_CONTROL_URL and BOT_CONTROL_TOKEN are set.

status.channels: {channels, plural, one {# channel} other {# channels}}, {categories, plural, one {# category} other {# categories}}
status.providersHint: The bot tries these in order. If the first is out of quota it fails over to the next, and a reply from a fallback looks exactly the same in Discord, so this is the only place you would notice.
status.loopsHint: These poll the AFC website for new tournaments, news and bans. A job that has not run in a long time is why announcements go quiet.
status.noLoopsYet: No job has completed a cycle since the bot started.

knowledge.title: What the bot knows
knowledge.hint: Documents the bot answers from. It reads them live, so a new file is used on the very next reply with no restart. The website scrape is separate and refreshes itself every 3 hours.
knowledge.empty: No documents yet. Add one to teach the bot something the website does not say.

settings.title: Channels, roles and timing
settings.hint: Saving applies immediately, with no restart. These decide where announcements land, so change them deliberately.

approvals.title: Waiting for a decision
approvals.hint: New tournaments and scrims are held here until somebody approves them. Approving posts the announcement to Discord immediately, exactly as the buttons in the mods channel do.
approvals.empty: Nothing is waiting. New tournaments and scrims will appear here as they are created.
